_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Segment Sleep & Breathing (pilier ~88%) puis sous-produits Devices/Masks (consumables), puis Residential Care Software (croissance), puis split geographique US vs ROW.

kpis.signal: Segment principal ~88% du CA, leader mondial CPAP/devices, renomme depuis FY25 (ex-Sleep & Respiratory Care)
kpis.description_fr: Segment historique ResMed (CPAP, masques, ventilateurs Astral). Vente d'appareils et consommables masques. Renomme Sleep & Breathing Health en FY25 vs ex-Sleep & Respiratory Care.
kpis.description_en: ResMed historical segment (CPAP, masks, Astral ventilators). Device and mask consumables sales. Renamed Sleep & Breathing Health in FY25 from Sleep & Respiratory Care.

kpis.signal: Flow generators CPAP/AirSense, principal driver hardware, beneficiaire du rappel Philips Respironics
kpis.description_fr: Ventes appareils flow generators (AirSense 10/11, AirCurve, Astral). Composante hardware de Sleep & Breathing Health.
kpis.description_en: Flow generator device sales (AirSense 10/11, AirCurve, Astral). Hardware component of Sleep & Breathing Health.

kpis.signal: Consommables recurrents, marge superieure aux devices, croissance forte FY24-25
kpis.description_fr: Ventes masques et accessoires (consommables). Revenu recurrent a marge elevee, complement des devices Sleep & Breathing Health.
kpis.description_en: Mask and accessory sales (consumables). Recurring high-margin revenue, complements Sleep & Breathing Health devices.

kpis.signal: Ex-SaaS, plateforme logicielle US/Allemagne pour soins residentiels, segment diversificateur
kpis.description_fr: SaaS residentiel (Brightree, MatrixCare). Plateformes logicielles US & Allemagne pour soignants. Renomme depuis FY25 vs ex-Software as a Service.
kpis.description_en: Residential care SaaS (Brightree, MatrixCare). US & Germany software platforms for caregivers. Renamed in FY25 from Software as a Service.

kpis.signal: Marche US ~64% du CA, premier marche CPAP au monde
kpis.description_fr: CA total Etats-Unis (tous segments). Marche n.1 ResMed, ~64% du CA global FY25.
kpis.description_en: Total U.S. revenue (all segments). ResMed's #1 market, ~64% of global revenue FY25.

kpis.signal: Europe, Asie, autres marches, diversification geographique
kpis.description_fr: CA hors Etats-Unis (Europe, Asie, Amerique Latine, autres). Diversification geographique.
kpis.description_en: Non-U.S. revenue (Europe, Asia, Latam, other). Geographic diversification.
